summary.text: A7 PRINT AS is a private limited company registered in Bergen, founded 1933-09-09. It was previously named LYSCOPICENTRALEN AS until 2006-09-06. Its main industry code is 18.120: other printing. The register shows 12 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 14 593 162 NOK and the annual result was 638 855 NOK; operating income was up from 13 186 019 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -300 977 NOK in 2024 to 638 855 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 1 198 660 NOK in 2024 to 1 557 516 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is a7print.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube profiles. The latest news on its own website is "Kunst printet på treplater" from 2025-10-23. The registered employee count went from 14 on 2025-12-13 to 12 on 2026-07-16. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-08 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
